description: Outbrain browser, image and S2S conversion pixels on exact /pixel and /unifiedPixel routes. Browser requests carry marketerId and can fall back from GET to POST sendBeacon. Checks populated page metadata and browser event guidance while preserving the documented S2S GET contract and currency list.

params.name: ob_adv_id
params.description: It is the Outbrain Advertiser ID. Generated noscript pixels send it. Outbrain documents the Marketer ID in GTM rather than this query, so the rule is ecosystem evidence.
params.fix_hint: Set `ob_adv_id` to the Advertiser ID from Amplify Tracking.

params.name: ob_click_id
params.description: It is the click identifier S2S conversions send instead of `ob_adv_id`.
params.fix_hint: Set `ob_click_id` to the `ob_click_id` captured from the landing URL.

params.name: name
params.description: It is the event name on the S2S postback. Outbrain documents it on the unifiedPixel URL. Page-view noscript pixels send `ev` instead and omit `name`.
params.fix_hint: Set `name` to the event name from Amplify, or drop the pair on a page-view pixel.

params.name: orderValue
params.description: It is the conversion value. Outbrain documents a decimal with a point, such as `4.99`, not `4,99`.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `4.99`, with a point and no currency symbol.

params.name: orderId
params.description: It is the advertiser order ID. Outbrain documents it so two conversions from the same user in a short window are not deduplicated.
params.fix_hint: Set orderId to the order ID, or drop the pair.

params.name: currency
params.description: It is the orderValue currency. Outbrain documents this fixed list of three-letter codes.
params.fix_hint: Use a documented code such as `USD` or `GBP`.

params.name: timestamp
params.description: Outbrain documents eight optional S2S timestamp representations. This advisory validates Gregorian calendar dates, 12-hour or 24-hour clocks and published numeric offset bounds. ISO UTC Z remains accepted for compatibility. Named zones retain their text without timezone membership, DST or instant resolution claims.

params.name: marketerId
params.description: The pinned browser SDK joins one or more configured marketer identities with commas. Fixed identity grammar is unpublished.

params.name: dl
params.description: The browser SDK sends an absolute page or referrer URL. An empty referrer is valid.

params.name: referrer
params.description: The browser SDK sends an absolute page or referrer URL. An empty referrer is valid.

params.name: pRef
params.description: The browser SDK sends an absolute page or referrer URL. An empty referrer is valid.

params.name: g
params.description: The SDK marks its GTM origin or sendBeacon fallback.

params.name: sb
params.description: The SDK marks its GTM origin or sendBeacon fallback.

rules.message: The pixel needs an advertiser identity, captured S2S click identity or browser marketer identity.
rules.fix_hint: Use ob_adv_id for an image, ob_click_id for S2S, or marketerId for the browser collector.

rules.message: An Outbrain S2S click identifier needs its configured event name.
The browser collector sends its configured event name.
The browser helper advises event names of at most 100 ASCII letters, digits, spaces or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit. Receiver rejection is not established.
The browser helper advises a currency for a populated positive conversion value.

params.name: query.ob_click_id
params.description: Outbrain S2S postbacks carry the captured click ID.

params.name: method
params.description: Outbrain requires GET for its S2S unifiedPixel postback.

params.name: query.marketerId
params.description: A browser identity separates the browser transport from the S2S method constraint.
